title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: Replacement Set for Lost Originals
content:
If originals of a `Bills of Lading and Transport Documents` set go missing while in circulation, the documentation party can ask Aurelia Hanse Line for a replacement set on the same document. This page covers the types on which that is possible, the security the party must give, the waiting period, the state the document must be in, and the effect of the replacement.

## Clauses

1. **Who and where.** The documentation party may request a replacement set for lost originals on a type that offers reissue.
2. **Security from the documentation party.** The request is registered and then remains pending with the documentation party, because only that party can sign the letter of indemnity and furnish the bank guarantee. The guarantee equals the declared cargo value on the document multiplied by the type's reissue guarantee percentage and divided by one hundred, rounded to the cent.
3. **Waiting period.** A replacement set may be issued no earlier than the type's waiting period after the loss was reported. The earliest reissue date is found by taking the calendar date on which the loss request was registered, ignoring the time of day, and advancing it by the type's waiting period in whole calendar dates. Reissue on that earliest date is allowed.
4. **Document still issued.** Replacement is possible solely during the period in which the document's status reads issued. Once a document has been surrendered or released, no replacement set is issued for it.
5. **Effect of reissue.** At reissue, any originals of the set in force that are still outstanding are declared void; the replacement goes out as the next set, numbered one above the set it replaces, with the type's full number of originals; and the reissue fee is charged, with no second issuance fee.
6. **Originals that reappear.** An original of the replaced set that is found after the reissue is void and releases no cargo.

## Values by document type

| Document type | Reissue offered | Waiting period (calendar days after loss report) | Bank guarantee (percent of declared cargo value) | Reissue fee (USD per set) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Sea Waybill | No | 0 | 0 | 0.00 |
| AHL Electronic Bill of Lading | No | 0 | 0 | 0.00 |
| AHL Straight Bill of Lading | Yes | 7 | 150 | 250.00 |
| AHL Negotiable Bill of Lading | Yes | 14 | 200 | 350.00 |
| AHL Combined Transport Bill of Lading | Yes | 14 | 200 | 350.00 |
| AHL Switch Bill of Lading | No | 0 | 0 | 0.00 |

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

An `AHL Straight Bill of Lading` declares a cargo value of 12,345.68 USD. The guarantee is 12,345.68 multiplied by 150 and divided by one hundred, that is 18,518.52 USD. The replacement is charged 250.00.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Document type | Loss request registered | Earliest reissue date | Proposed reissue date | Allowed? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Straight Bill of Lading | 9 January, 16:40 | 16 January | 16 January | Yes |
| AHL Straight Bill of Lading | 9 January, 16:40 | 16 January | 15 January | No |
| AHL Negotiable Bill of Lading | 20 November, 08:05 | 4 December | 4 December | Yes |

## Basis Q&A

**The document was surrendered for a telex release and an original is then reported lost. Is a replacement set issued?** No. Reissue is available only while the document is issued.

**Does the replacement set carry a new issuance fee?** No. Only the reissue fee applies.
